turns.text: ngl its almost midnight and im trying to plan next week around thanksgiving. need a thank-you note to send and a reminder text for my mom. can you help me lay it out

Happy to. A few quick questions so the plan fits your week:

1. Who is the thank-you note for, and what are you thanking them for?
2. What should the reminder to your mom be about?
3. What days next week are already booked (classes, work, anything else)?

so today i helped my mom pack grocery boxes at the gurdwara for the thanksgiving food drive, was there all afternoon. thank-you is for the volunteer coordinator there, she let us take over the packing table. reminder for my mom is to bring the extra boxes and tape to the next pickup. also gurpreet asked about my CDL again lol

Nice work today. Here's a draft for each.

**Thank-you note (to the coordinator)**
"Hi [coordinator's name], thank you for letting my mom and me take the packing table at the food drive today. It was great to help get the boxes ready, and I'm glad to pitch in again next time. Best, [your name]"

**Reminder text to your mom**
"Hey Mom, reminder to bring the extra boxes and tape to the next pickup. I can carry them if you want."

As for the CDL question, you can just laugh it off with something like "maybe someday" unless you're actually considering it. Want me to build the week plan next? Tell me which days are busy and I'll slot the note and reminder in.

ok. i ran the delgado park loop this morning since the boardwalk is still flooded, about 4 miles. tmrw im at my parents place on pell road for dinner, she always sends me home with a tub of dal. classes mwf 9-12 and tue/thu 10:30. career center desk friday

Here's a simple plan:

| Day | Plan |
|---|---|
| Sun | Dinner at your parents' place. Send the thank-you note before you head over, and text your mom the reminder in the morning so it's fresh. Bring home the dal for lunches. |
| Mon | Classes 9-12. Evening: prep or weekend-style catch-up. |
| Tue | Class at 10:30. Check that the boxes and tape plan is settled. |
| Wed | Classes 9-12. Good day for anything pre-holiday you still need to wrap up. |
| Thu | Class at 10:30. |
| Fri | Career center desk shift. |
| Sat | Your Delgado Park run, then rest. |

Since the dal covers a few meals, you can skip big cooking early in the week. Want me to adjust anything or set exact send times for the messages?
